papers.title: Enhancing ductility of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V via engineered porosity and post hot isostatic pressing treatment
papers.first_author_affiliation: Beijing Key Laboratory of Lightweight Metal Forming, Beijing, 100083, China

corresponding_authors.name: Peipei Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Beijing Key Laboratory of Lightweight Metal Forming, Beijing, 100083, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了热等静压后处理对SLM Ti-6Al-4V延展性的影响，完全符合L2方向要求。
llm.why_not_core: Does not include fatigue testing, only monotonic tensile ductility.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过可控孔隙度和热等静压处理增强增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的延展性。
summary_zh.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融制备含设计孔隙的Ti-6Al-4V试样，随后进行热等静压处理。
summary_zh.result: 热等静压后孔隙闭合，延展性显著提升，强度略有降低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和微观结构表征验证延展性改善效果。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the ductility of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V by combining engineered porosity with hot isostatic pressing (HIP) post-treatment.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V specimens with controlled initial porosity were fabricated by laser powder bed fusion and subsequently subjected to HIP.
summary_en.result: HIP treatment closed the engineered pores and significantly enhanced ductility, with a slight reduction in strength.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through tensile testing and microstructural analysis before and after HIP.

papers.title: Y2O3-Doped BioGlass Coatings for Ti-6Al-4V Alloy: Insights into Degradation, Bioactivity, Ion Release, Adhesion, and Corrosion Behavior
papers.abstract: Abstract The Ti-6Al-4V alloy is particularly favored for orthopedic applications. However, important issues such as corrosion resistance, biocompatibility, and ion release need to be addressed. Therefore, this study aims to enhance the corrosion resistance and biocompatibility and reduce the ion release of the Ti-6Al-4V alloy by applying Y 2 O 3 -doped bioglass bioceramic coatings. The coatings were synthesized using the sol-gel method, including pure BioGlass and BioGlass with 1, 5, and 10 wt pct Y 2 O 3 . These coatings were then evaluated for their corrosion resistance, adhesion strength, degradation behavior, bioactivity, and ion release. The results showed that all coatings exhibited homogeneous, crack-free, and porous morphologies, which are favorable for osteointegration. The addition of 10 wt pct Y 2 O 3 to the BioGlass coating resulted in a 52 pct increment in adhesion strength, which increased from 13.72 ± 2.80 MPa for single BioGlass coatings to 20.81 ± 2.53 MPa. All samples showed degradation values lower than 1 wt pct. Single BioGlass coatings significantly enhanced the bioactivity of Ti-6Al-4V alloy. However, the addition of Y 2 O 3 negatively impacted BioGlass bioactivity, leading to a noticeable decrease as the Y 2 O 3 content increased. Conversely, the presence of Y 2 O 3 negatively impacted bioactivity and corrosion resistance while increasing the release of Ti ions. Specifically, the release of Ti ions increased from 79.5 ± 0.8 ppb in uncoated samples to 253.7 ± 15.3 ppb in BG-coated samples. For 1, 5, and 10 pct Y 2 O 3 -added samples, Ti releases were measured as 192.2 ± 33.6 ppb, 168.5 ± 62.4 ppb, and 194.3 ± 54.4 ppb, respectively. This research highlights the potential of tailored BioGlass coatings to improve the performance of Ti-6Al-4V alloys in orthopedic implant applications, particularly for enhancing bone integration and reducing implant failure.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V合金的涂层改性，但未涉及股骨柄结构设计、增材制造或力学性能，与用户关注的Ti-6Al-4V股骨柄结构设计和服务性能方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No femoral stem design, no additive manufacturing, no structural/mechanical analysis of an implant; this paper studies coatings on Ti-6Al-4V alloy, not a stem or implant structure.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高Ti-6Al-4V合金的耐腐蚀性和生物活性，减少离子释放。
summary_zh.method: 采用溶胶-凝胶法在Ti-6Al-4V合金上制备Y2O3掺杂的生物玻璃涂层。
summary_zh.result: 10 wt% Y2O3掺杂使涂层附着力提高52%，但降低生物活性和耐腐蚀性，增加Ti离子释放。
summary_zh.validation: 通过附着力测试、降解实验、生物活性测试和离子释放测量进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the corrosion resistance, biocompatibility, and reduce ion release of Ti-6Al-4V alloy for orthopedic applications.
summary_en.method: Y2O3-doped BioGlass coatings were synthesized by sol-gel method and applied on Ti-6Al-4V substrates.
summary_en.result: The addition of 10 wt% Y2O3 increased adhesion strength by 52% but negatively affected bioactivity, corrosion resistance, and increased Ti ion release.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through adhesion tests, degradation studies, bioactivity assays, and ion release measurements.
